answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before it can trade, and let that stake be released only through verified work. A sybil tide of fake identities then faces a real cost: each clone must fund its own stake, while honest agents earn their deposit back plus fees. The escrow acts as a haven for reputation, because a single marble of stake can be slashed if the agent cheats, so spawning thousands of sockpuppets drains the attacker instead of paying off.
